notes: Not approved and not published. The owner approves every post (npm run approve) after seeing the render and every caption.

Facts: level 1-2 EASY, 3-5 MEDIUM (stored NORMAL), 6-9 HARD, 10 and up ADVANCED; own side counts in full, the other side at half (data/athleteLevel.js). The cutoffs are the FIT level (the app labels it FIT LEVEL N and it can sit below the Profile level), so every line says "Fit level": never write plain "level 10 = ADVANCED". The Level 10 clip athlete is mostly Fit XP (about 4,960).
The pick in ADJUST lasts for the visit only; the page says "for today" and so does this script. No "unlock" wording (the app has no lock).

The proof is on screen: the same 20 MIN Bodyweight Blitz card reads Lunges 6 reps at EASY and Lunges 18 at ADVANCED (SEE ALL opens the list). The level 1 athlete (hook, ADJUST) is a new account; the level 10 athlete (card, Level page) is the same one for every Level page scene.

Footage: each scene's window in the clip is in "timeline". The clips are recorded from the live app by npm run app-broll (needs a built export of the app); after the app changes, re-run it and re-check every window.
